prerequisites: Finished bachelor graduation from a Technical University.

learning_outcomes.text: Gain basic knowledge in computer aided techniques in metal forming and metal casting processes through education.

syllabus_topics: Utilization of Numerical Simulation by FEM in Metal Forming and Casting Processes.
Introduction into CAD in Foundry technology, use of Foundry TechnologyIII calculator
3D modelling of castings with risers, material carbon steel and ductile iron
Simulation of solidification of a steel casting
Simulation of solidification of a ductile iron casting
Changes of process parameters, design of a gating system
Simulation of mould filling and casting solidification
Proposal of a forging sequence, design of a forging model - simulation
Choice of boundary and initial conditions - simulation
Simulation - possible change of process parameters
Simulation evaluation - comparison of both processes simulation
bibliography: Návod k práci se simulačním softwarem NovaFlow&Solid ; Návod k práci se simulačním softwarem FormFEM
Herman a kol. Počítačové simulace ve slévárenství, ČVUT, 2001
